images.alt: Photo of four people sitting side by side on a wooden deck, viewed from behind, looking out across farmland toward tree‑covered hills and mountains. One person has an arm around the person beside them. A dark blue banner across the lower part of the image reads: ‘Have your say: Consultation open until 18 May 2026’, with a QR code and the text ‘Scan me’. At the bottom of the image are the Te Kāwanatanga o Aotearoa New Zealand Government logo and the Ministry of Health Manatū Hauora logo.
